How to read this comparison

The left map is the frozen v2 symmetric reconstruction. The right preserves previous assignments except a bounded source-reviewed Co1 LSp-to-dl correction, assigns previously unresolved white matter using reviewed source-compatible compartments and explicit anatomical priors, and restores exterior support only within separately reviewed masks. These additions are inferred, not new experimental observations. The inventory target is 908 tissue identities at 34 levels; this does not certify every anatomical extent.

The optional Allen drawing is rotated, translated and scaled into the comparison frame, with its original annotation text retained. Clean maps contain only official-ID palette pixels. Guides are for inspection and are off by default.

Click either map or a legend entry to highlight a region in both maps. Press Escape to reset. The clean PNG download contains the full completed label image, without guides, change shading or highlights. Evidence 2 denotes reviewed source-bounded support; 3 denotes a registered published SpinalJ prior; 4 denotes a modeled anatomical boundary. Unchanged v2 assignments are evidence 1, remaining unknown tissue is 5, and the source-reviewed correction is 6.

Derived from Allen Mouse Spinal Cord Atlas P56 drawings · C1–C8 / T1–T13 / L1–L6 / S1–S4 / Co1–Co3
